name: OowOah VR Meeting Room & Quantum Leap
summary:
Step into a fully immersive VR meeting experience with OowOah — built to go beyond traditional platforms like Zoom and Teams. OowOah places you inside a true virtual meeting room where you can connect, collaborate, and present as if you were physically together.

Key features include full-size presentation screens for impactful presentations, AI-powered main meeting notes that automatically capture key points, and personal note-taking tools so every participant can track their own ideas. Navigate naturally
